ResearchProjectDef.label: Interactive tables
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build sleek spacer tables with an embedded smart display. When seated at this table, colonists enjoy passive television-style recreation alongside meals or work.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Outdoor solar lamp
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build an electrical standing lamp that lights an area, good for large outdoor spaces. It has a small solar panel mounted on top. It s electrical charge during the day, when it’s off, and automatically turns on at night.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced chair
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a high-end, spacer-era seating solution with adaptive cushioning, posture calibration, and breathable smart fabrics. Designed for maximum long-term comfort and sleek modern interiors.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Modern couches
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build sleek, spacer-era armchairs and couches. Built with memory foam, smart-fabric upholstery, and ergonomic design, it provides superior comfort and aesthetics.
